detailed_descriptions_html.en:
The Lion & Eagle DLC is a full-scale expansion for Master of Command, introducing two new playable nations: Sweden and the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth. Command disciplined Swedish armies through military-school reforms, or guide the Commonwealth through the politics of the Sejm, fielding new regiments, doctrines, officers, reforms, encounters, and music across newly added regions of Europe.

Includes:

  • 2 New Nations: Sweden and the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth

  • 83 New Units, with 40 Swedish units and 43 Polish-Lithuanian units

  • 14 New Universal Doctrines available to all regular nations, expanding tactical options across the entire game

  • 9 Swedish Doctrines and 6 Military-School Reforms, allowing Sweden to shape its army through rival military traditions

  • 9 Polish-Lithuanian Doctrines and 10 Sejm Reforms, letting the Commonwealth ratify powerful reforms through its parliament

  • New Swedish Regions and Polish-Lithuanian Regions added to the campaign map

  • 12 New Officer Traits to further define your commanders and their battlefield roles

  • 10 New Unit Items to customize and improve your regiments

  • 8 New Encounters bringing fresh events, choices, and campaign stories to your march

  • 28 New Flag Emblems, including 15 Swedish emblems and 13 Polish-Lithuanian emblems

  • 2 New Music Tracks, with one theme for Sweden and one for Poland-Lithuania

Whether you march under the Swedish lion or the Commonwealth eagle, this expansion brings new ways to build your army, reform your nation, and fight your way through the cabinet wars of the 18th century.
